angleRead.name: Mason Ortega
angleRead.text: I’m standing outside SpeedyBurger on a Tuesday afternoon, watching Devon Willis work the counter between rushes. She’s the only named server on the ledger for this stretch of Downtown, and the place is big — thirty-one people on the books, but I want to know what her shift actually looks like. Not the numbers, but the rhythm: the line, the regulars, the tips. Down the block, Andre Turner is on the line at Miso Metro — a two-person kitchen, so he’s probably doing everything. I want to ask him what he’s worried about when the tickets stack up. Temple Lounge is dark this time of day, but I know the night crew comes in later — I’ll hang around the door, see if I can catch someone headed in, thou
